https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iTuzmmItGNY

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 Snow Rabbit 主辦的黃金巫術法杖錦標賽之全攻擊型特殊 BO3 賽制。
  • 見證作者與「爆破蒼龍」（Dran Buster）展現的驚人極限絕殺，包含生涯最不可思議的逆轉復活名場面。
  • 透過緊張刺激的攻防細節與陀螺配置調整，感受高水準陀螺對決的熱血碰撞與心理博弈。

摘要

全攻擊型賽事開幕與首戰交鋒

作者參加了由 Snow Rabbit 主辦的黃金巫術法杖錦標賽，本次賽事採用相當特殊的全攻擊型限制與三戰兩勝（BO3）規則。首局對戰中，作者第一顆陀螺選擇了Wizard Rod嘗試以迴轉持久取勝，第二顆則派出Dran Buster全力擊發，成功打出震撼的極限終結（Extreme Finish）。儘管換邊後遭遇對手 Dran Dagger 與發揮穩健的 Silver Wolf 強力壓制，作者在關鍵第四局依舊信任夥伴，果斷再次派上 Buster 迎擊，並成功以極限終結擊破對手，順利拿下第一場大局。

絕境逆轉：陀螺生涯中最瘋狂的復活對決

進入第二輪後，對手 Leon 的猛烈攻勢讓作者陷入苦戰，Wizard Rod 被撞進得分袋，Buster 也因運氣欠佳吞敗。迅速調整心態的作者在後續回合穩紮穩打，接連利用 Wizard Rod、Buster 與 Shark 連續拿分，比分一度來到 3 比 0。然而 Wizard Rod 隨後慘遭爆裂終結，壓力再度落到 Buster 身上。在 Buster 對決 Leon 的靈魂宿命戰中，上演了作者陀螺生涯中最瘋狂的對局：Buster 雖被對手猛烈撞飛，卻在瀕死邊緣奇蹟般復活反擊，順勢將 Leon 撞入極限區再度斬獲極限終結，震撼全場。

激戰決賽與遺憾收尾

在第三輪的最後決戰中，戰局陷入高強度的拉鋸對抗。面對強敵 Wyvern 與 Shark，作者雖然靠著 Scepter 與 Shark 的精準發揮分別斬獲極限勝利，但在關鍵第三場中開局不利，Devil 與 Scepter 接連失分，Scepter 更不幸落入兩分袋。儘管作者在最後一把發射 Shark 時傾盡全力，仍遺憾未能挽回劣勢。作者最終雖與Spirit Scepter擦身而過，但這場充滿激情與逆轉的錦標賽依然讓他十分過癮，並相約下次再戰。

================================================

Today I’m participating in the Golden Wizard Rod tournament hosted by Snow Rabbit. The rules are quite unique this time; besides being limited to all-attack types, it’s a BO3, best of three. Let's take a look. >> Everyone, please raise your right hand. >> I am a true beyblade fighter; in beyblade, anything is possible. For my first pick, I chose Wizard Rod. With this driver, even against an attack type, I have a chance to outspin them. The second beyblade is Dran Buster. I launched it with full power, trying to knock the opponent out. Wow, Buster got.

an extreme finish, winning the second match of the BO3. Switching sides, I originally sent out Buster hoping for a quick win, but I was caught off guard by his Dran Dagger, which knocked me into the extreme zone. After my tenth beyblade, Buster lost to the outspin, ending the second set. Last round after switching sides, only my Wizard Rod outspun, while Buster lost and Shark lost to Silver Wolf. His Silver Wolf is truly so stable. I’m pretty sure he’ll pick Silver Wolf for his fourth, so I’ve decided to use Buster for a showdown of bonds. I launched the beyblade with all my strength, aiming for maximum burst—.

and it worked! As expected of my Buster , it secured another extreme finish. Moving to the second round, his Leon was super aggressive; my Wizard Rod was directly slammed by his Leon into the two-point pocket. Second beyblade, Buster against Shark. I felt my positioning was good, and Buster moved just as I intended, but my luck wasn't there. Adjusting my mindset for the second BO3, I took it one point at a time. Only Buster lost a point, and we headed into the third set at 4 to 1. I stayed steady, picking up points one by one. Wizard Rod outspun, the second, Buster, was super cool with an extreme.

dash that knocked his Leon out, and finally, Shark also won by outspin. The score reached 3 to 0. Naturally, I sent out Wizard Rod, hoping to exploit the weakness of his Leon Claw, but I forgot I was using this driver. Dead, my base was immediately burst. No worries, I trust Buster. Buster faces Leon once again; it’s a duel of soul-bonded beyblades. This match is absolutely insane, really ridiculous. This is the most insane match I've ever played in my beyblade career. My Buster was knocked flying by Leon, then suddenly revived, and then Leon went into the extreme zone . My Buster really wanted to win; it got.

another extreme finish. In the third round, Wizard Rod steadily secured a point. But in the attack showdown, Devil outspun Shark, and the third Shark was knocked straight into the Extreme Zone by Wyvern. Too strong! In the second match, I sent out Devil first to try and score big, but unfortunately, it couldn't beat Shark in rotation speed. Thankfully, the second Scepter held firm , causing his Pegasus to stall and enter the Extreme Zone. An extreme victory! For the third, my Shark faced Wyvern. Shark finally performed well, successfully knocking out Wyvern— another extreme victory! Entering the.

third match, a rough start. Devil lost the battle. I sent out Scepter for the second launch, hitting twice in a row, then it was my turn to lose and fall into the two-point pocket. Third launch with Shark, I pulled with all my might. Oh man, such a shame, it keeps coming back! There was nothing I could do; that's the third round of the final tournament. >> 767 >> Although I didn't get the Spirit Scepter , I played a lot of Beyblade today. Snow Rabbit, let's do it again next time!
